review_scope: Exhaustive archive, section and paragraph completeness checks; targeted five-language comparison of evidence boundaries, tactical terminology, conclusions and prose. This is not a claim of independent line-by-line historical certification of twenty manuscripts.
notes: Chinese and English pages, including the shared Traditional Chinese reading path, remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
EP05 preserves the distinction between later retellings of psychological assessments and verifiable original documents; it also retains the multiple competing lineages of the 4-2-4 formation.
EP06 preserves the distinction between understanding Garrincha's violence and excusing it, and retains conflicting accounts of the procedure allowing him to play the final.

EP06 supplied translations correctly say sent off, not shown a red card in 1962. Chinese uses the anachronistic red-card phrase. Retained as a disclosed source discrepancy; no silent edit to Chinese/English. FIFA confirms cards were introduced at the 1970 World Cup: https://inside.fifa.com/en/tournaments/mens/worldcup/1966england/news/1966-world-cup-gripping-tales-and-inspirational-traffic-lights-2812820

EP07 supplied tactical terminology means without wingers, not without forwards, consistent with the described Hunt/Hurst frontline. Chinese's shorthand 无锋 is recorded as a source wording issue. FIFA reference: https://www.fifa.com/de/tournaments/mens/worldcup/articles/wm-1966-england-bundesrepublik-deutschland
EP07 keeps accusations separate from proof of manipulation and retrospective image reconstruction separate from an official re-ruling.

EP08 preserves personal appreciation versus a purported objective ranking, and differing time/participation counts versus genuinely different events. German title uses Farbaufnahmen rather than Farbfilm to avoid narrowing moving images to a particular medium.
Copyedits address awkward collocations and overpunctuated prose without abridging arguments or normalizing away the author's recurring motifs.

ep05.de.before: Ob die einzelnen Formulierungen tatsächlich so lauteten, lässt sich nicht mehr sichern.
ep05.de.after: Ob die einzelnen Formulierungen tatsächlich so lauteten, lässt sich nicht mehr mit Sicherheit feststellen.
ep05.de.reason: Use the idiomatic verb for establishing the exact wording of a reported assessment.

ep05.es.before: Y es precisamente esa imposibilidad de saberlo con exactitud lo que hace que, partido tras partido, este deporte siga mereciendo volver a verlo y volver a jugarlo.
ep05.es.after: Y es precisamente esa imposibilidad de saberlo con exactitud lo que hace que, partido tras partido, siga valiendo la pena ver y jugar este deporte una vez más.
ep05.es.reason: Repair the awkward merecer-plus-infinitive construction while retaining both watching and playing.

ep05.ja.before: そして、この計算しきれなさこそが、このスポーツを、一試合また一試合と、もう一度見るに値し、もう一度プレーするに値するものにしている。
ep05.ja.after: そして、この計算しきれなさこそが、一試合また一試合と、もう一度見たい、もう一度プレーしたいと思わせる。
ep05.ja.reason: Replace the cumbersome nominal construction with natural essay prose; preserve the value of watching and playing again.
